maya: Hi folks  First day here, M2 MacBook Air, zsh. Ran the dotfiles installer from the handbook but my `which ruby` -> /usr/bin/ruby and asdf says ruby 3.2.2 is installed. asdf shims are at ~/.asdf/shims but not first in PATH. Also I can't figure where to stash REDWOOD_API_KEY locally for quick play. Any short zsh-specific checklist?
leo: welcome! :wave: Common zsh gotcha: on mac use ~/.zprofile to export PATH for login shells. Make sure you prepend asdf shims: `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/shims:$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"` and run `eval "$(asdf init zsh)"`. Then `asdf reshim ruby` after install.
maya: ah the installer appended to ~/.zshrc, moving that to ~/.zprofile fixed the PATH ordering. Ruby now points to asdf. Thanks.
leo: for REDWOOD_API_KEY we prefer direnv locally. Add `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` to a local .envrc in the project and `direnv allow`. If you want a dev key, 1Password > Redwood > Dev Keys has personal test keys, else open a ticket in #support.
devex-bot: (bot) Hi maya! If you'd like pairing help, reply "pair" and I'll DM a calendar with available DevEx engineers. Also see https://handbook.redwood.dev/onboarding/dev-setup for step-by-step.
maya: running into GPG pinentry when importing my commit signing key: pinentry-curses missing. Any mac fix?
frank: install `pinentry-mac` via brew: `brew install pinentry-mac`, then set `pinentry-program $(brew --prefix)/bin/pinentry-mac` in ~/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf and `export GPG_TTY=$(tty)` in your shell rc. Restart agent: `gpgconf --kill gpg-agent && gpgconf --launch gpg-agent`. That usually fixes GUI prompt issues.
leo: small extra tip: check `brew --prefix` is /opt/homebrew (arm). If not, reinstall brew for arm64 or adjust flags when building native gems. For openssl-linked builds set LDFLAGS/CPPFLAGS to openssl@3 in /opt/homebrew before `asdf install ruby`.
maya: fixed gpg and direnv, running tests now. Big thanks, y'all! Will ping if CI creds or anything else needed.
